name: z80-skills
description: Standalone adaptive workflow, thin Z80 domain routing, and specialist development, audit, organization, size, and optimization skills.

interface.longDescription: Bundles an independent workflow, a thin Z80 domain selector, and five specialists. Routing chooses one domain contract; workflow chooses execution effort; each specialist retains its evidence, safety, and mutation gates.
defaultPrompt: Use $route-z80 to choose the right specialist for this Z80 repository request, then continue with that route.
Use $audit-z80 to audit this mixed ASM/C project for correctness risks using only current local evidence.
Use $shrink-z80 to recover 512 bytes and verify net savings against fresh build artifacts.
